name: web-dev
description: Web development in one plugin: a web-developer worker (routing, REST/API integration, forms, state, SSR/CSR), an opus-floored frontend-reviewer for component and view logic, and three version-pinned stack skills — Next.js (App Router boundaries, opt-in caching, server actions, 14→16), React Native (lists, navigation, native-driver animation, Expo inversions), Vite (VITE_ env security, chunking, base, proxy, 5→8) — with /web-dev:review detecting the stack from the lockfile. Inertia and Laravel stay in their own plugins; plain JS/TS needs no skill.
